vson_p:
(c / Composition
    :framedBy (cam / CameraView :angle high :focalLength 24mm :framing wide_shot)
    :framedBy (sc / SceneContext :venue outdoor :atmosphere clear :timeOfDay day)
    :framedBy (vs / VisualStyle :aesthetic realistic :palette natural :medium photography)
    :viewedBy cam
    :depicts (f / PhysicalObject :class Fjord
        :individuation Named :animacy Inert :countability Count
        :bbox2d "0.00,0.00,1.00,1.00"
        :hasQuality (q1 / Quality :dimension Color :value blue))
    :depicts (m1 / Aggregate :class MountainRange
        :individuation Generic :animacy Inert :countability Collective
        :bbox2d "0.00,0.00,1.00,0.60"
        :hasPart (m2 / PhysicalObject :class Mountain
            :individuation Generic :animacy Inert :countability Count
            :bbox2d "0.00,0.00,0.50,0.60")
        :hasPart (m3 / PhysicalObject :class Mountain
            :individuation Generic :animacy Inert :countability Count
            :bbox2d "0.50,0.00,0.50,0.60"))
    :depicts (c1 / PhysicalObject :class Cliff
        :individuation Named :animacy Inert :countability Count
        :bbox2d "0.00,0.40,0.50,0.60"
        :hasQuality (q2 / Quality :dimension Material :value rock))
    :depicts (p / Aggregate :class People
        :individuation Generic :animacy Agentive :countability Collective
        :bbox2d "0.00,0.60,0.50,0.40"
        :hasPart (person1 / PhysicalObject :class Person
            :individuation Generic :animacy Agentive :countability Count
            :bbox2d "0.00,0.60,0.50,0.40"))
    :depicts (sf1 / SpatialFact
        :figure f :ground m1
        :rcc EC :directional below :viewer cam)
    :depicts (sf2 / SpatialFact
        :figure c1 :ground f
        :rcc EC :directional left_of :viewer cam)
    :depicts (sf3 / SpatialFact
        :figure p :ground c1
        :rcc EC :directional below :viewer cam))
